meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 它会分析你改动过的 NanoClaw 代码,把自定义内容整理成一份迁移指南;升级时先取干净的官方版本,再按指南把你的改动重新套回去,不做 git merge,所以不会因冲突卡住。
howto.when: 当你想把自定义过的 NanoClaw 分支升级到上游、避免 git 合并冲突,或要求生成迁移指南/执行迁移时触发;它会先检查工作区并确认改动范围。

say.text: 帮我生成迁移指南,把我在这个 NanoClaw fork 里的改动记录下来。
say.note: 会先检查工作区、评估改动范围,然后写入迁移指南。

say.text: 升级到上游吧,按迁移指南重新应用我的自定义改动。
say.note: 会在干净工作树里套用改动,避免合并冲突。

say.text: 已有迁移指南,直接跳过提取,开始升级。
say.note: 检测到指南后可直接进入 Upgrade 阶段。

howto.what_en: Analyzes the fork's customizations, writes a markdown migration guide, then upgrades by checking out clean upstream and reapplying changes from the guide — no git merge, so no conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when upgrading a customized NanoClaw fork to upstream and you want to avoid merge conflicts, or when asked to generate/run a migration. It first checks the working tree and scope.

say_en.text: Generate a migration guide that records my changes in this NanoClaw fork.
say_en.note: Checks workspace, assesses changes, writes the guide.

say_en.text: Upgrade to upstream and reapply my customizations from the guide.
say_en.note: Applies changes on a clean worktree, avoiding merge conflicts.

say_en.text: A guide already exists; skip extraction and start the upgrade.
say_en.note: Detects existing guide and moves straight to Upgrade phase.
